label.description: Label rendered above (or beside, for binary controls) the input.

description.description: Helper text rendered below the input. Hidden when `error` is set.

anyOf.description: Library-level extension of the standard `Error` type. Frappe's whitelisted methods may return an error with multiple messages on `messages?: string[]`. This is the shape input components render in their error region.

error.description: Error message rendered below the input. When set, the control receives `aria-invalid="true"` and `data-state="invalid"`. May be either a string or an `Error` object whose `messages?: string[]` is rendered as stacked lines (with `Error.message` as the fallback).

required.description: Marks the field as required. Renders an asterisk next to the label and forwards `required` / `aria-required` to the underlying control.

id.description: HTML id of the underlying control. Auto-generated via `useId()` if omitted.

side.description: Preferred popover side relative to the trigger.

align.description: Alignment of the popover along the trigger edge.

offset.description: Gap between the trigger and popover content in pixels.

placement.description: Preferred popover placement relative to the trigger.

format.description: Display format used for the input text.

variant.description: Visual style variant passed through to the input.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected.

open.description: Controls popover open state (for controlled usage).

openOnFocus.description: Opens the popover when the input receives focus. Default: false.

openOnClick.description: Opens the popover when the input is clicked. Default: true.

typeable.description: Whether the trigger input accepts typed input. When `false` the user can still open the popover and pick a date, but cannot type a date manually. Default: `true`.

readonly.description: Prevents manual typing while keeping the picker interactive.

disabled.description: Disables the trigger input and calendar interactions.

clearable.description: Shows clear and quick-action controls when enabled.

keepOpen.description: Keeps the popover open after a date is selected. Default: false.

autoClose.description: Closes the popover after a value is picked.

min.description: Earliest selectable date. Accepts `YYYY-MM-DD` (or, for `DateTimePicker`, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` for second-level granularity).

max.description: Latest selectable date. Accepts `YYYY-MM-DD` (or, for `DateTimePicker`, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` for second-level granularity).

isDateUnavailable.description: Return true to prevent a date from being selected. Combined with `min`/`max`.

allowCustom.description: Allows users to type custom date text into the input.

inputClass.description: Additional classes applied to the trigger input.
inputClass.deprecated: Apply `class` directly to the DatePicker component element to control width.

value.description: Uncontrolled initial value for the picker.

minDateTime.description: Earliest selectable date-time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

maxDateTime.description: Latest selectable date-time in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` format.

allowCustomTime.description: Allows typing a custom time into the embedded time picker.

actions.description: Sidebar rendered to the left of the calendar. Use for date-time shortcuts ("Now", "Tomorrow 9am") and other preset actions. When omitted, the popover shows the calendar and time picker only.
